title: SymbolicSystem: data coordinates - the data of the items, their postNewton steps and the solvers
author: Claude-JG
description: Maintainer 2026-10-29: data coordinates are needed in the future (SymbolicSystem refuses them now; SystemVariables leaves them out). The data coordinates of NodeGenericData in the recordings (ObjectConnectorUser has them, #3102), their postNewtonStepUserFunction recorded, the PostNewton step of the explicit and generalized-alpha solvers of symbolicSystem.py as Exudyn does it (discontinuous iteration, recommended step size), data in SystemVariables and in Equations (as fixed values per step), checked against SolveDynamic on a contact or friction model.
